notes: Superior Court Judge Gregg A. Padovano set the borough's Fourth Round obligations at 65 present need and 480 prospective need. DCA's initial calculation was 497 units; Borough planner found errors in land data reducing it to 463; court settled on 480. HEFSP adopted by Planning Board June 19 2025. Borough Council adopted rezoning resolution for Becton Dickinson campus December 22 2025. Borough pursuing Certification of Compliance and Repose by March 15 2026 to secure immunity through 2035. Three main development sites: (1) Becton Dickinson campus (800 units, 160 affordable — Hekemian Group / SHG Franklin Lakes LLC); (2) Cigna/former IBM site at 400 Parsons Pond Road (495 units, 62 affordable — SHG, settled November 2023 via Ordinance No. 1927; amended October 1 2024 via Ordinance No. 1964); (3) Municipally-sponsored 100% affordable site on 3.5 acres donated by SHG (65 units, 71 affordable credits). Originally sited near McCoy Road; 3.5 acres comes from SHG under Cigna settlement. Mayor and Council approved settlement agreements with SHG and FSHC for Cigna site. Settlement date for Fourth Round consent order with FSHC not confirmed. Surprise late proposal for a portion of the Becton Dickinson site emerged during planning discussions.
